source: Kuperman, Stadthagen-Gonzalez & Brysbaert (2012), AoA of 30k English words (BRM), merged w/ SUBTLEX-US frequency; kid-safety filtered.

axes.difficulty: 1 (easy) .. 10 (hard): overall 'level' of the word — how advanced, long, and rare it is (bee-style ramp). Composite of AoA, length, syllables, rarity.
axes.trickiness: 1 (regular) .. 10 (trap): misspelling risk even when you know the word — double/silent letters, ambiguous suffixes, ie/ei, sound-spell gap. Short-but-tricky words (rhythm, necessary) score high here.
